title: Kindred — Share with neighbours. Find local help within 100km.
narration: Introducing Kindred. The community app for your street. Just local. No money. No ads. No algorithm. Three simple steps. Post a give or an ask. A neighbour messages. Drop it off or pick it up. Made for locals. Be kind. Use Kindred.

beats.headline: Post a give or an ask.
beats.body: Snap a photo. Tag it GIVE or NEED.

beats.headline: A neighbour messages.
beats.body: Sort a time and a pickup spot.

beats.headline: Drop it off or pick it up.
beats.body: Or have a yarn while you hand it across.
